note: Codemagic is the flagship product of Nevercode OÜ (Tallinn, Estonia; CEO Triin Kask), a mobile CI/CD provider founded ~2015 and rebranded its product from 'Nevercode' to 'Codemagic' around 2019 (old domain nevercode.io redirects to codemagic.io). No funding round, investor, or revenue figures could be confirmed: Crunchbase, PitchBook, Tracxn and Growjo pages returned 403s, and DuckDuckGo/Google/Bing/Yandex/Ecosia/Mojeek/Startpage/Marginalia/Brave all returned bot-detection challenge pages rather than results during this research session, so absence of evidence here should not be read as evidence the company never raised funding — it is simply unverified within the time budget.
